headword: {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}

definitions.explanation: Any drink that contains dissolved carbon dioxide, producing bubbles. Includes cola, ramune, cider, sparkling water, and other effervescent drinks.

examples.japanese: {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}が{好|す}きだ。
{暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}は{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}がおいしい。
examples.english: Carbonated drinks taste great on hot days.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}を{控|ひか}えて、{水|みず}を{飲|の}むようにしている。
examples.english: For my health, I've been cutting back on carbonated drinks and drinking water instead.

notes:
A compound of {炭酸|たんさん} (carbonic acid, carbonation) and {飲料|いんりょう} (beverage). This is the standard general term for any carbonated drink, commonly seen on product labels, vending machines, and menus.

USAGE:
The formal term used in product categories and labels. In casual speech, people often just say {炭酸|たんさん} to mean carbonated drinks in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}を{飲|の}む — to drink a carbonated beverage
- {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}の{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき} — a vending machine for carbonated drinks
- {無糖|むとう}{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう} — sugar-free carbonated drink

RELATED TERMS:
- {炭酸水|たんさんすい} — sparkling water; carbonated water without flavoring
- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい} — soft drink; the broader category including non-carbonated drinks
- ラムネ — ramune; a classic Japanese carbonated drink with a marble stopper
